summary: Relate a movable plane to its intersection with a double cone.
objective: Let me tilt a plane through a double cone and inspect circle, ellipse, parabola and hyperbola cases.
example_prompts: Let me tilt a plane through a double cone and inspect circle, ellipse, parabola and hyperbola cases.

entities.name: Double cone
entities.guidance: Use both nappes and clearly mark the apex; transparency must not obscure the intersection curve.

entities.name: Section plane
entities.guidance: Render a thin bounded display patch with normal arrow; identify the mathematical plane as unbounded.

entities.name: Intersection
entities.guidance: Compute a curve from the same cone and plane equations; crop with endpoint indicators rather than fake closed loops.

state_contract.model: Right circular double cone and normalized plane equation; finite mesh is a viewport crop.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.

invariants: Curve points satisfy both equations within declared numeric tolerance.
A plane through the apex requires a separate degenerate classification.
A clipped parabola or hyperbola must not be called a bounded curve.
motion_guidance: Derive each frame from plane parameters; transition progress is not physical time.
Use static presets around the parabola threshold to avoid misleading numeric flicker.
known_limits: No robust arbitrary quadric classifier supplied.
Finite tessellation and near-tangent numerical conditioning need implementation checks.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Nondegenerate plane sections of a right circular double cone include circles, ellipses, parabolas and hyperbolas.
claims.scope: Plane avoids the apex; classification depends on relation to the generators.
